thread:
Ravi (oncall): :rotating_light: Pager: GPU autoscale failing in eu-central-1. HPA not reacting to external metrics; queue for gpu-inference up to ~1200. 429s and some 504 timeouts reported.
PagerBot: Incident opened INC-2026-4377. Severity: P1. Notifying oncall, eng-sre, infra.
Nina (eng-sre): I'm looking at prometheus -> metrics-adapter path. I see a burst of scrape latency around 17:05 UTC, then adapter returned 502s. Logs: 
```
W0105 17:05:12.345 metrics_adapter.go:128] scrape error: read tcp 10.0.0.12:9091->10.0.0.3:54932: i/o timeout
E0105 17:06:01.129 controller.go:219] external metrics store error: failed to list metrics: context deadline exceeded
```
Carlos (infra): nodepool is at ASG cap (max size). We can't increase automatically. Manual scale would require approval for burst nodes.
Ravi (oncall): customer impact? Elena?
Elena (customer-ops): three customers hitting errors at higher percentiles, one queueing requests for minutes. Sent initial heads-up to impacted AEs.
Nina (eng-sre): HPA events: "failed to get external metrics" repeated. If metrics-adapter doesn't provide metrics, HPA will not scale beyond current replicas. Possible root cause: prometheus overloaded (high scrape cardinality) or metrics-adapter stuck on GC.
SupportBot: Quick checklist recommended: 1) Reduce low-priority workloads, 2) Force HPA minReplicas bump, 3) Restart metrics-adapter, 4) Failover to hosted cluster.
Carlos (infra): I can cordon some noncritical GPU nodes and drain lower-priority pods to free GPUs temporarily. Will start with batch workloads.
Ravi (oncall): Nina, can you try to restart only the metrics-adapter pod to re-register external metrics? If that fails, we'll patch HPA to minReplicas.
Nina (eng-sre): Doing: `kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deploy/metrics-adapter` now. Also preparing HPA patch: `kubectl patch hpa gpu-inference -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":8}}' --type=merge` (will apply if adapter restart doesn't restore metrics quickly).
Carlos (infra): I've started draining gpu-batch-{0..3}, evicting lower-priority pods. Expect ~4 GPUs freed in ~90s.
Ravi (oncall): Initiating route-based mitigation: throttle anonymous and free-tier to 2 concurrent requests to reduce QPS. ETA immediate.
Elena (customer-ops): Notified impacted customers of temporary throttling and manual scaling actions. One customer asked about SLA credits; logged ticket.
Nina (eng-sre): metrics-adapter restarted. Initial logs show TLS handshake issues with prometheus targets: `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` for prometheus-exporter-3. That's odd — cert rotation events occurred 2 days ago.
Carlos (infra): We've rotated certs for exporters last night; maybe some agents didn't pick up the new CA. I'll roll the exporter DaemonSet on affected hosts.
Ravi (oncall): While infra acts, please apply HPA bump to avoid more queue growth.
Nina (eng-sre): Patch applied. HPA minReplicas=8. HPA controller now has desired=8 but still waits for metrics to determine further scale. Pods will schedule if nodes available.
Carlos (infra): Manual ASG increase requested +6 nodes (approved). New instances launching, expected Ready in ~4-6m.
PagerBot: Alert: GPU pool usage decreased below 90% threshold -> suppressing page.
SupportBot: Note: route throttle applied to free tier. Use `redwood routes get` to verify.
Nina (eng-sre): Adapter logs now show successful scrapes for external metrics: `inference_queue_length`, `gpu_util_pct`. HPA has external metrics and is evaluating.
Ravi (oncall): pods are pending due to image pull; nodes still coming up. Carlos status?
Carlos (infra): Nodes in Ready state now, kubelet registering. Scheduler placing pods — pod count rising from 3 -> 12.
Elena (customer-ops): latency for impacted customers improving; one reports retry logic recovered some requests. All three customers updated.
Nina (eng-sre): Queue length down to ~150 and falling. 429s almost gone, 95th latency approaching normal. Attaching prometheus scrape timeline and adapter logs to INC-2026-4377.
Ravi (oncall): Good work. We're going to hand this to infra rotation for post-incident RCA. Key action items: 1) investigate exporter cert rotation gap, 2) add adapter health alert (scrape error spike / external metrics missing), 3) ensure ASG burst approvals faster or automatic emergency scaling path, 4) add fallback routing to hosted pool when HPA has no metrics.
PagerBot: Handoff recorded to infra-rotation.
Ravi (oncall): Closing active pager. If anything regress, reopen this thread. :thumbsup:
